prompt: How many $\frac{1}{4}$-inch cubes fit inside a $1$-inch $\times$ $1$-inch $\times$ $1$-inch box?
hint: How many fit along each edge?

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Tag every length with its units. Area answers are square units; volume is cubic.
How many fit along each edge?

explanation: Each edge of the big box fits $1 \div \tfrac{1}{4} = 4$ small cubes.
